## Summary
Provides data channel writing helpers for reliable and unreliable channels with bitrate-aware retry and drop behavior. The package also owns a sliding-window bitrate calculator used to estimate buffered throughput.

## Responsibilities
- Calculate recent data channel bitrate over a sliding time window.
- Wrap data channel write operations with deadlines.
- Retry reliable writes when receivers are not considered slow.
- Drop unreliable writes when buffered amount would exceed target latency.
